assignmentHtml.task: Research Dangal TV Channel YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator: Dangal Media / GDPL (Global Digital Public Limited). Corporate chain. (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages (Hindi). (6) Primary content category (Indian TV serials). (7) Content supply model: broadcaster archives. (8) Representative series. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Dangal TV Channel is #25 with ~70B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Dangal TV Channel with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Dangal TV Channel YouTube Dossier

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UCNzmmbXIbMzlqE8nD1PBXfg
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNzmmbXIbMzlqE8nD1PBXfg
  • Alternative alias URL: https://www.youtube.com/c/DangalTVChannel
    Sources: Wikitubia page confirms channel ID; multiple search results confirm canonical URLs.
  1. OPERATOR AND CORPORATE CHAIN
  • Operator: Enterr10 Television Network Pvt Ltd (also styled as Enter10 Television Pvt Ltd)
  • Registered legal entity: ENTER 10 TELEVISION PRIVATE LIMITED (CIN: U51102MP1998PTC012813), incorporated May 8, 1998
  • Founder & Managing Director: Manish Singhal (founded company in 2004)
  • Corporate chain: Enterr10 Television Private Limited → Dangal TV Channel
  • NOTE: No evidence found linking GDPL or 'Global Digital Public Limited' to Dangal TV despite extensive searching. All corporate references consistently identify Enterr10 Television Pvt Ltd as the owner/operator.
    Sources: Tracxn company profile; dangalplay.com contact page; Wikipedia; LinkedIn.
  1. CHANNEL CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
  • Channel created: August 2, 2017 (confirmed by both Social Blade and Wikitubia)
  • First video uploaded: August 11, 2017 (per Wikitubia);
  • Second video uploaded: September 27, 2017 (per Wikitubia);
  • By mid-late December 2017 they were uploading daily; by early 2018 approximately every 30 minutes.
  • The exact identity of the first video could not be independently verified beyond the date. A Facebook post from Dangal TV on August 11, 2017 reads 'Today's movies #DangalTVChannel,' suggesting early content was movie-related.
    Sources: Social Blade; Wikitubia; Dangal TV Facebook page.
  1. OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • Displayed country: India 🇮🇳 (per Communitrics)
  • Headquarters: Mumbai and Indore, India (Wikipedia); Registered office: 141, Saket Nagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452001 (Tracxn/dangalplay.com); Corporate office: Mumbai, Maharashtra
    Sources: Communitrics; Wikipedia; Tracxn; dangalplay.com.
  1. LANGUAGES
  • Hindi
    Sources: Wikipedia (Language field: Hindi); Wikitubia ('free-to-air Hindi channel'); Communitrics tags.
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
  • Indian TV serials / General Entertainment
  • Communitrics categorizes the channel under 'Entertainment', also tagged under TV shows and Movies.
  • Description states: 'India's Favorite Family Entertainment Channel' and 'a leading 24-hour Hindi General Entertainment Channel'
    Sources: Communitrics; YouTube channel description (from search snippets).
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL: BROADCASTER ARCHIVES
  • Confirmed broadcaster-archive model: In 2015, Dangal TV converted to a Hindi GEC 'by acquiring and aired most of the Hindi television shows from the former defunct Entertainment channel Imagine TV and along with television channels like DD National, Star Plus, Sony Entertainment Television, Zee TV, Colors TV and Sahara One' (Wikipedia).
  • In 2021, Dangal TV stopped airing acquired shows and shifted exclusively to original content, moving acquired shows to newly launched sister channel Dangal 2 (Wikipedia, Wikitubia).
    Sources: Wikipedia; Wikitubia; Contentasia interview.
  1. REPRESENTATIVE SERIES
    Original programming (per Wikipedia Category: Dangal TV original programming and Dangal TV Wikipedia article):
  • Crime Alert (first one-hour TV show based on real-life crimes in India)
  • Bahurani (first original reality show)
  • Shivarjun: Ek Ichhadhari Ki Dastaan (first original soap opera)
  • Mann Sundar, Mann Atisundar, Nath – Zewar Ya Zanjeer, Gehna – Zewar Ya Zanjeer
  • Aye Mere Humsafar, Pyaar Ki Luka Chuppi, Ranju Ki Betiyaan, Prem Bandhan, Prem Leela
  • CIF, Control Room, Dalchini, Sindoor Ki Keemat, Janani – AI Ki Kahani
  • Kaisi Teri Dillagi, Rimjhim – Choti Umar Bada Safar, Pati Brahmachari, Hamari Bhabhi Number 1
  • Brij Ke Gopal, Jai Hanuman, Phir Laut Aayi Naagin, Tose Naina Milaai Ke
    Notable milestone: An episode of India Alert posted October 23, 2019 became the channel's most viewed video.
    Sources: Wikipedia; Wikitubia.

evidence.snippet: Dangal TV is an Indian general entertainment television channel owned by Enterr10 Television Network. It was launched in 2009 as a Bhojpuri-language movie channel but was later converted into a Hindi entertainment channel... In 2015, it was converted into a Hindi general entertainment channel by acquiring and aired most of the Hindi television shows from the former defunct Entertainment channel Imagine TV...
evidence.supports: Ownership by Enterr10 Television Network; broadcaster archives content supply model; launch history

evidence.snippet: Dangal TV Channel was created on August 2, 2017. Back then, Dangal TV Channel had no upload schedule. The first video was uploaded on August 11, 2017. The second video was later uploaded on September 27, 2017... On October 23, 2019, they posted an episode of India Alert, which later, became their most viewed video.
evidence.supports: Channel creation date (Aug 2, 2017); first upload date (Aug 11, 2017); most viewed video date
